BiblicalUsage: Azay means then — at that time. The psalm sings, then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us; then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul. Three thens in one psalm, and each one is a danger God stopped.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that every then in this psalm is a then that did not happen, because the Lord was on our side — and that is the story of my life too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
